name: Truth or Trap
description:
Truth or Trap is a fast and fur-ious quiz game full of surprising facts, sneaky traps, and a touch of feline mischief.

Each round, one player becomes The Big Meow and challenges the others with two items from a quirky category – maybe both are true, maybe one’s a trap - maybe it’s all a lie!  Can you tell which is which?

Everyone secretly bets paw tokens on their guesses, and you only win if you get both right!  Get it wrong, and you’ll lose your bet and one of the shared nine lives.  When all lives are gone, the round ends and the cat with the most paws wins a Golden Sardine!  Collect two and you’re crowned the cleverest cat!

Expect bluffing and laughter in this quiz game of knowledge, guess work and some pure feline instinct!

—description from the publisher
